reviews.text: We are very happy with our screens from Lone Star Solar Screens! We contacted them a week ago, they came out and gave us a quote the next day, and installed them 6 days later!! Amazing service and such a quick turnaround. We look forward to the impact on our electric bill. Our house already feels so much cooler 😊 We would recommend them to anyone looking to save money on their electric bill. Thanks, guys!

From my first interaction with the sales rep Paul, to the installation with Juan and Cristobal, the process was professional, fast, and exceeded my expectations. I contacted them on a Monday, met with them the next day, for measurements on Thursday, and installed on Saturday. Super fast for 33 screens. They look amazing and my home already feels cooler during the day.  I went with black 90% and champagne frames. I would highly recommend this company. Photos attached of my home!

I got a referral from them from a neighbor in my community who used them for her windows and it looked great. Lone Star Solar Screen was fantastic to work with! They came out the very next day to take measurements and had everything installed the day after. The team was professional, communicative, and efficient from start to finish. Great experience all around — highly recommend!

Great product and service!

This is our second time buying from them and they always have great service. Guys show up on time and explain everything. They custom made screens and installed in three days.

The outcome is great. The heat reduction is very noticeable.

Side note that’s cool- the guy who came out has been there since he graduated HS, 23 years   He said there are several others that have been there for over 15. That speaks to the quality of the company.

From the initial phone call to the day of install, I have been very  pleased with the customer service, price and quality.  Our sales rep Victor C was on time to measure, explained the process, delivered a very fair quote, then cut me loose so that he could make final measurements and notes.  I called to confirm the order later that day and 2 days later I had screens installed by Victor C and Victor.  They look great!

I purchased Lone star solar screens about 2 years ago. The screens look amazing and does a good job. However this review is about their very poor customer service. Ive called multiple times to get a screen replaced due to bad weather. Ive been told everytime I call, that someone would call in a couple of days. Well it's been 9 days, no phone call. A message to the owners, stand by your word and have some integrity towards your customers. Disappointing.

My solar screens look great and really elevate the look of our home. It was a great experience working with Lone Star and I highly recommend them. They answer their phones- which is a huge plus in this day and age and provided exactly what we wanted in a very short time frame.

These Solar Screens make a world of difference for our residents. Not only does the exterior look better, but our overall electric bill has made improvement.! LoneStar is quick when responding to repairs and estimates. Highly recommend!
Roy did a great job making recommendations I didn’t think of. Very professional and quick to install. Very reasonable pricing.

I contacted Lone Star Solar Screens for a quote. Paul contacted me and scheduled an appointment and showed up as scheduled. He explained the product choices and cost to do my entire house. I was so impressed with the quote that I decided to place my order. Screens were installed a few days later.

Used this company before with no problems a few years ago. Send tech to measure for new screens, they call night before to tell me tech would be out tomorrow to measure. Figured they would call before to give a heads up on when they would be there like they did on the initial sales call. I come home to the work van parked in the middle of the driveway preventing me from getting in the garage or driveway (not a huge deal but a little annoying) the screens are in the backyard and I have 2 large do

Thorough and fast quote. Reasonable pricing, no down payment required (COD). Great workmanship. Friendly and respectful installation team. We have chosen buffalo color with 80% and it looks great! They went above and beyond. I would highly recommend them to any homeowner.

There seems to be common thread as to the outright rudeness of customer service.  I spoke with a salesman and told him that we just had our windows replaced and needed new screens on three of the windows and needed a rough estimate. I also told him that I had the "cut sheets" from the window factory providing all the window dimensions. The salesman told to me send the "cut sheets" to the email address he provided and they would send me a price, this salesman was also polite. Two weeks later I st

I have used Lone Star for over 10 years. No complaints. Easy to schedule , easy to communicate with, and easy to do business with, knowing that the screens are of good quality and you have peace of mind.

Easy to get a quote with a reasonable price, with no upfront payment until work is completed to satisfaction. The screens look good and we noticed a significant difference in lowering the temperature upstairs, since the screens were installed in June 2024. I hope the solar screens will last and the warranty will be honored when the time comes.
I will recommend them to anyone looking to install solar screens on windows.

Lone Star Solar Screens did an excellent job in both pricing and installation of solar screens on my rental property.  I highly recommend them to everyone, AND they were on schedule which is hard to find these days.  Thank you.

Great Job to Paul & Jim for providing a great experience again! This is their 3rd visit to my home for new work! Not sure on other reviews on here! I am a real customer who will keep it real! Every time I have spoken to Jim he is welcoming and Paul who came to my home to do measurements is super cool! Eric the installer who came today was super nice and welcoming. Prices are great, fast response time and quality work!

I've used Lone Star on a couple of my properties and absolutely love their service and product. Rep Paul  was professional and knowledgeable when coming to my home to provide cost and service info. Moreover, I love the ability to pay in 2 installments.  Thank you!

Stopped in to open up a new contractor account and was astounded by the service I received. Jim was truly top notch and I am so glad I stopped in. Looking forward to working with these guys in the future!

I've used them indirectly in the past and know the quality of the work is also top notch and they stand behind their products.

Loved my screens! Called, they came and gave me a quote super quick! Wasn’t able to be in person when they came due to my work schedule however they accommodated me and installed my screeens as soon as they could! Made the process super …

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic. The company delivers good service and product for many customers, leading to detailed, positive reviews. However, there is a consistent pattern of negative reviews citing unprofessionalism and communication issues, which is credible. The high Angi rating is a potential outlier but common for the platform.
fake_signals: Angi rating is unusually high compared to other platforms, which may indicate selective solicitation or platform-specific incentives
authentic_signals: Specific details in positive reviews (employee names, timelines, product specs)
Varied writing styles and reviewer profiles
Mix of very positive and very negative experiences
Long-term employee mentions indicating stable company
data.discrepancy_explanation: Angi rating (4.9) is significantly higher than Google (3.9) and Yelp (3.3). This is a common pattern where contractors perform better on lead-generation sites like Angi than on open review platforms. The Google and Yelp ratings are more consistent with each other.
